signature: (on garland): “M. IACOB SCHMIDT STADT HAUTBOIST IN NURNB”; maker’s mark, bird standing on branch, with “III S” above.
remarks: tubular slidestays, lower slidestay telescopic, floral pattern (like Kodisch) on both slide stays; ferrules have simple ring pattern; tenon dented on end, has bad dent near junction with first ferrule; six ferrules on slide sec.; saddle and ring at slide bow; solder repair on bow opposite ring; saddle has characteristic Nuremberg pattern; 2 ferrules at slide bow of different lengths; slide is removeable but sprung; no slide stockings; bell stay has elaborate Nuremberg-style floral decoration, with eye; garland has scallop shape, with round dollops of brass; Nuremberg-style rim wire, folded edge visible under bell; leaf pattern on rim wire; garland decorated with floral pattern; examined by the author August 2002.
